prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: large flat flagstone paving for a town square: rectangular pale grey-beige slabs (about 28 x 20 art pixels) in staggered rows, worn edges, small cracks, thin dark joints. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable game ground texture, premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Entire image is an evenly detailed expanse of large flat rectangular pale grey-beige worn flagstone paving in staggered brick-pattern rows, slabs roughly 28 x 20 logical art pixels. Classic top-down orthographic overhead town-square surface, no perspective. Crisp uniform square art pixels, each enlarged by approximately 7–8 image pixels, strictly nearest-neighbor hard edges. Hand-placed cohesive clusters of 3–10 art pixels, 4–6 shades per material, warm yellow-beige highlights and purple-red shifted muted shadows, thin dark joints, tiny restrained chips and small cracks, worn slab edges. Soft even neutral upper-left ambient overcast illumination, clean base colors. CRITICAL: perfectly seamless repeating texture: shapes, joints, and slabs interrupted at left edge resume exactly on right edge; top edge matches bottom edge. Uniform distribution, no dominant features. Surface only edge-to-edge, no borders, frame, objects, characters, words, shadows, glow, night lighting, blur, antialiasing, noise, dither, photographic detail or checkerboard.
